title: 2 Moves vs 3200 Engine
summary: Tony gets two moves for every one move of chess.com's Komodo engine at 'Maximum (3200)'. A check made with your first move ends your turn. He wins as White (Nf3-Ne5 then Qf3/Qxf7 ideas, mate ~2:39) and again as Black (e5, Bc5 then mate on f2 ~3:51). Short proof-of-concept video.
rules: Player makes 2 consecutive moves, engine makes 1.
If the player's first move gives check, the turn ends immediately (no second move).
win_condition: Checkmate the engine; two games (as White, then as Black).
